labels.comments: We stayed in this air bnb for two days, one night and it was absolutely perfect for my 11 year old son and I. The views are spectacular, it was clean and modern, and the beds were super comfortable.

Great place to stay at. The apartment was a lot bigger than I expected and I loved how the hosts included amenities you would only get at a hotel. The WiFi connection was great; we were able to stream without any issues. Bed was comfy and extra blankets were provided.  The location was perfect!  A convenience store and a Tim Hortons at your doorstep; the subway was about 2 blocks away which was perfect for getting around. The hosts were already very quick to respond whenever I had a question. All around great deal.
Nice place to stay. Free parking in front of the house. Hosts provide all the things you may need. It would be great if there was a microwave however.
labels.note: toàn khen nhưng mong muốn có thêm lò vi sóng, vẫn là positive

labels.comments: Great location! Lots of shops and restaurants near by. Enjoyed our stay very much. The space was cute and clean

This house is beautifully decorated and very comfortable.
Most of the appliances are new and we were able to cook our breakfast every day.
It was clean.
Bas was quick to reply our messages.
I do recommend this place and would love to stay there again in the future.

The townhouse is in great location for access to Toronto, bars and restaurants and public transport. Would recommend for a couple.
Can be a bit noisy with the apartment above but if you are out seeing Toronto you won’t be home to notice.
labels.note: có khen nhưng chê ồn ào; mixed vì vừa khen vừa chê

labels.comments: Melissa was a great host and responded quick to everything. She was very helpful and made sure me and my friend had everything we needed to enjoy our stay. Great location and easy to get around to places quickly. I highly recommend this place.
Great place to stay. Very clean The mattress is very comfortable. And supper close to the transit system.

My experience was amazing. Fatima and Marcus are attentive.
The apartment was perfect and clean. The location was fundamental to have a great and safe experience in Toronto. I loved everything!
I recommend Fatima and Marcus apartment! It’s clean, safe, great location, quite and cute!
Sincerely,
Alex
Very well located. Free parking was a bonus. Only issue was that tenants above the apartment were extremely loud and you can hear everything. Overall great stay

labels.comments: I had the pleasure of staying at Melissa’s wonderful suite for two weeks. It was everything I could’ve asked for. It was clean and tidy. With a walking distance to great asian restaurants and markets, I was always well fed. Great location to TTC stops (busses and street cars) made it easy to get around Toronto. Having a full washer and dryer for stays over 7 days, makes for a huge bonus. Spacious suite with great amenities. Melissa was a great host, always available for questions and very friendly! Would recommend to anyone.
Place was very clean and right next to CN Tower  and the pictures are good but a must see in person.. worth every dollar, Believe me!!!!

Anja’s place is lovely. It is cozy, wonderfully decorated and with many amenities. While travelling for work it was the perfect spot to relax at the end of the day. Thank you, Anja for being a lovely host.
A great stay at a very safe neighborhood in Toronto that is very close to the downtown area. Very clean, comfortable, and nice place to stay. Good for individuals and couples.
Very clean and spacious suite. Hosts were very courteous, and quick to respond to any messages/concerns. Hassle free and relaxing stay.

Very nice accommodation.  You quickly feel at home.  Very well located, you are quickly in downtown Toronto. Tony responds quickly to our questions.  I will definitely be going back to the Kool Haus for my next trip to Toronto!

Leo's place is great, its super comfortable and cozy with everything a traveler need.
Also the place is always super clean, they put a lot of effort in making the olace look good and clean all the time.
I stayed for two weeks and had an amazing time, Leo is a really good host always willong to help and give good advice to travelers.
I would definatly stay here again if i get the chance

Natalija’s place is literally so awesome! It is right off of Queen West and the TTC is steps away making it so easy to get around the city. The bed is super comfortable and the place was very clean. I HIGHLY recommend her place and will continue to stay there anytime I head to Toronto!

Sandy was a great host! I stayed twice there in the same trip. Her place is located seconds away from great shops and public transport, on a quiet street. The place was clean and comfortable. Highly recommended!

Quiet, very clean place, very comfortable bed, and well-appointed bathroom. Keep in mind that's the extent of the space. The wifi was so-so, but acceptable. Beth was considerate and prompt in responding, and there were no problems checking in. The location was good for us, though parking can be a bit of a problem throughout that neighbourhood.
labels.note: vừa khen vừa chê một chút về wifi và parking
